payload.text: ST0002/WP02 lands after hv's compact (vc's word), with three commits added to its range first, which ride on its run (vc): (a) vc's share leniency: a malformed weekly_scoped_shares, a bad entry or a share outside 0..100 leaves those windows with no share instead of refusing the snapshot, a unit test per malformed form, and under --model the reason says the model's share is unknown instead of a bare eligible; (b) cc's tightening: soonest is taken among usable accounts whose weekly window gives a reset, none when none does; (c) cc's text nit: an undated choice's reason says no eligible account gives a weekly reset.
